title: ligularia virgaurea var. oligocephala
intro: Ligularia virgaurea var. oligocephala, commonly known as the Japanese goldenseal or Japanese ligularia, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular choice for treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ligularia virgaurea var. oligocephala include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
